obfuscation_indicators: known and unknown risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The excerpt provides meaningful quantified tax-loss carryforwards, valuation allowances, liquidity, and cash balances, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and management estimates. Key risks include uncertainty around deferred tax asset realization, impairment assumptions, financing availability, and an outdated Section 382 analysis. Liquidity is presented positively, although the stated sufficiency depends on future operating cash flow and access to capital.
